html:
Jewelry Store Lead Generation

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers looking for customers who want to sell gold, get appraisals, or buy engagement rings. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

• First 3 leads free • $40 per accepted lead thereafter • Optional Pro website widget at $12/month

Why CaratBase

CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to surrounding metros.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Can I cancel the Pro widget at any time? Yes. The Pro widget can be cancelled whenever, and it drops back to the free version.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
